# The stack substitutes two constants that a sixteen-token sequence cannot
# reach: coarse_ratio stands in for the architecture's ratio-128 compressor on
# odd layers from 3, and selected_row_cap stands in for its 512 selected
# compressed rows on even layers from 2. raw_window 2 stands in for 128. The
# fine ratio (4), the layer-type alternation, and the indexer rule are real.
#
# The stack is also emitted as a real GGUF file and reloaded through readGGUF.
# That file is generated into the test's temporary directory and never checked
# in, per binary-fixtures forbidden above. It is synthetic, so the pinned
# identity gate (validatePinnedProfile) rejects it; the test asserts that
# rejection instead of relaxing the gate.
